title: Focused median bias reduction
summary: Median bias reduction of maximum likelihood estimators can substantially improve estimation and inference. Existing generally applicable methods are, however, implicit, requiring the solution of nonlinear systems of estimating equations for a specified parameterization. Their application to parameter transformations often involves tedious algebra and bespoke implementations. We develop an explicit median bias-corrected estimator for focus parameters that are smooth scalar transformations of a chosen reference parameterization.
